question_text: Construct recommend(items, target, score) in Python. items is nonempty; score(item, target) returns an integer suitability. Return the item with highest suitability, breaking equal-suitability ties by greater item.stock. If both are equal, keep the first item. Negative suitability is possible.
adaptation_rationale: Corrects official sample lexicographic bug; retains object-list selection with primary/secondary/first-tie policy and tests counter examples.
